# Rows 89..98 of the native extern table (nbx_libc_rows.mind, mark nblibc03), one Python literal
# (ast.literal_eval) that native_lane_value_shapes_smoke.py appends to NATIVE_ONLY_CASES: a list of
# row dicts with the keys that list documents. Built by the stdin protocol only (the front door's
# Rust admission does not carry these names).
# (a committed seed carries the mark nblibc03: every row runs in the default run)
# `--mint-stage1 OUT` builds a stage1 from this tree with the frozen seed; `--only libc_rows`,
# `--only libc_rows_mlir` and `--only parts` run against it. The seed advance drops the key.
# `libc_rows_mlir` (`front_door: "mlir"`) builds the same six programs with `--backend mlir`:
# a cross-check, never the reference.
# Controls: every refused_* program CALLS its extern under a declaration that differs from the row: an
# unknown neighbour (accept), a wrong arity (bind), a wrong parameter width (listen fd i64,
# sendto length i32) and a wrong result (getenv *mut u8, close *const u8). Its twin_* partner is
# the same call under the declaration that equals the row (`accept` has no row: its twin is the
# neighbour getsockname); the twin builds and returns 42, so the refusal of the refused_* program
# comes from the declaration.
# udp_rows: sendto passes rdi rsi rdx rcx r8 r9 as movsxd rdi, mov rsi, mov rdx, movsxd rcx, mov r8,
# movsxd r9 (the i32 addrlen); recvfrom's last two are pointers (mov r8, mov r9); an i32 result
# is movsxd rax,eax.
